description: The first Go single-binary STAC CLI: every search filter the Python tools have, plus an offline cache, scene ranking, coverage, and asset resolution no other STAC tool offers.

novel_features.name: Least-cloudy scene
novel_features.description: Pick the single clearest scene over an area and date range.

novel_features.name: Cloud-cover histogram
novel_features.description: Show the cloud-cover distribution over an area and date range.

novel_features.name: Coverage check
novel_features.description: Answer whether data exists over an area and when, with a temporal summary.

novel_features.name: Scene timeline
novel_features.description: Build a per-date time series of scenes for change detection.

novel_features.name: Temporal gaps
novel_features.description: Find missing acquisition windows over an area versus expected revisit.

novel_features.name: Watch new scenes
novel_features.description: Report scenes published over an area since the last check.

novel_features.name: Asset URL resolution
novel_features.description: Resolve an item's band and asset download URLs, provider-aware.

novel_features.name: Compare collections
novel_features.description: Compare two collections over the same area and date range.

novel_features.name: xarray stack snippet
novel_features.description: Emit a ready-to-paste stackstac/odc-stac Python snippet for matched scenes.
